Messages.Author: Richard W. Parker
Messages.Body:
I was recently playing a game of Jyhad, and my opponent brought out the
KRCG News Radio card.  So I, being in a typical wierd Jyhadian frame of mind,
realized that the radio station letters MUST have been chosen for some reason.
RCG...hmmm...Richard C. Garfield???

My question to the group: I have looked in every bit of MtG or Jyhad paper
that I could find, and could not find a single reference to Richard Garfield
that showed what his middle initial is.  So, IS his middle initial a "C", and
if so, am I correct in my assumption that the initials were intentionally
chosen for that reason?  Or am I just trying to read WAY too much into this
stuff?  ;-)
-- 
                                       -- Richard Parker (rwparker@netcom.com)
